alcazprison.name: Tidemistress Ca'zass
alcazprison.note: First boss, in the round room at the south end of the corridor from the entrance; kill the two naga adds first and interrupt their Polymorph

alcazprison.name: Overseer Wrex
alcazprison.note: In the round hall at the end of the cross corridor; clear the cells around first, he pulls all nearby mobs; his key opens the locked door to Katerina

alcazprison.name: Katerina the Cleaner
alcazprison.note: Down in Maximum Security at the junction of the lower corridor, east of the stairs; leave the chained prisoners alone

alcazprison.name: Blazeroar
alcazprison.note: In the middle of the large four-lobed hall at the end of Maximum Security; the prisoner Zarla Ober turns into the red dragon Blazeroar

alcazprison.name: The Questioner
alcazprison.note: Last boss, in the octagonal hall north of the west junction, on the way out; talk to Mason Connery in Blazeroar's hall first, or his quest is lost

alcazprison.name: Commander Folkar
alcazprison.note: In the cells next to it; a quest giver for the Horde, chained and hostile for the Alliance; not in the game's boss list, tick him off by hand

blackfathom.name: Aku'mai
blackfathom.note: Step out of his poison clouds right away

blackfathom.name: Baron Aquanis
blackfathom.note: Summoned at the Fathom Stone; not in the game's boss list, tick him off by hand

blackfathom.name: Old Serra'kis
blackfathom.note: In the Forgotten Pool: jump into the water and swim under the shrine; he fights underwater, watch your breath

blackmawhold.name: Withermaw
blackmawhold.note: First boss, at the west end of the Festering Grotto by the pond; the cave mouth is east of the lake, the grotto is a dead end

blackmawhold.name: Bonesnout the Unbroken
blackmawhold.note: Patrols Bonesnout's Thicket by the log walkway; shielded until the four Legashi Ritualists are dead

blackmawhold.name: Blackmaw Behemoth
blackmawhold.note: Underground in the big red hall (Depths of the Burrow); through the gate east of Bonesnout's Thicket, down past the quest giver

blackmawhold.name: Varrox Bleakhoof
blackmawhold.note: At the very bottom in the purple magic circle (Depths of Forbidden Magic); through the round hole next to the Behemoth's hall

blackmawhold.name: Elder Shaman Bloodmane
blackmawhold.note: In the green glowing room (Depths of the Elders); back up past the Behemoth's hall and north; kill the Devotees around him first, interrupt his Chain Lightning

blackmawhold.name: Unbound Spirit
blackmawhold.note: Last boss, at the big wooden hut (Depths of the Fallen Grove); talk to the friendly furbolg Elder Bramblesnap to start the fight

blackmawhold.name: Impaan the Imprisoner
blackmawhold.note: Optional: place from one addon only, not in the video run; in the middle of the thorn ring at Defiled Peak

blackmawhold.name: Moontouched Wanderer
blackmawhold.note: Rare, not in every run: south of Bonesnout

blackmawhold.name: Gortek the Apprentice
blackmawhold.note: Rare, not in every run: by the skull next to Varrox's circle

blackrockdepths.name: Ring of Law
blackrockdepths.note: Arena event: step onto the grate in the middle; two waves, then a random boss

blackrockdepths.name: Golem Lord Argelmach
blackrockdepths.note: Clear the Manufactory first: when pulled he calls all remaining golems and technicians

blackrockdepths.name: Plugger Spazzring
blackrockdepths.note: Buy the 6 Dark Iron Ale Mugs for Rocknot before you attack him: hitting him or any patron turns the whole bar hostile

blackrockdepths.name: Phalanx
blackrockdepths.note: Way on: back door upstairs. Give Private Rocknot 6 Dark Iron Ale Mugs (from Plugger), he blasts it open; then Phalanx attacks

blackrockdepths.name: Ambassador Flamelash
blackrockdepths.note: Kill the fire spirits before they reach him: each one that arrives makes him stronger

blackrockdepths.name: The Seven
blackrockdepths.note: Talk to Doom'rel to start; the seven attack one after another

blackrockdepths.name: Magmus
blackrockdepths.note: When pulled, the statues in his hall spew fire: fight him out of the flame jets

aliases: 铁炉堡公主茉艾拉·铜须
blackrockdepths.name: Princess Moira Bronzebeard
blackrockdepths.note: Heals the Emperor. For her quests leave her alive: killing her fails them.

blackrockdepths.name: The Vault
blackrockdepths.note: Optional: Watchman Doomgrip appears once all 12 relic coffers in the Vault are open (the keys drop from trash)

blackwinglair.name: Razorgore the Untamed
blackwinglair.note: Event: control him with the Orb of Domination and destroy all eggs; then he fights

blackwinglair.name: Vaelastrasz the Corrupt
blackwinglair.note: Talk to him to start the fight

blackwinglair.name: Nefarian
blackwinglair.note: Talk to him on the throne to start; drakonid waves come first

aliases: Atrexis el Caballero de la Tumba
Atrexis le Chevalier de la tombe
dalaran.name: Atrexis the Grave Knight
dalaran.note: First boss, at the ritual circle in the middle of the sewers

dalaran.name: Arcane Anomaly
dalaran.note: At Krasus' Landing on the surface

dalaran.name: Mana Devourer
dalaran.note: In the courtyard north of the dome of the Violet Hold; clear everything around him first, every mob left alive joins the fight

dalaran.name: Fel Ancient
dalaran.note: In the middle of the city (Runeweaver Square): kill the treants, then talk to Magus Fansy Goodbringer south of the barrier to lower it

dalaran.name: Arcanic Enigma
dalaran.note: Called Arcanic Enigma in the game; in the Path of Renewal corner east of the city centre; kill the two Mana Phantoms first

dalaran.name: Unstable Sentinel
dalaran.note: In the Magus Commerce Exchange north-east of the city centre; kill the Angry Tomes first

dalaran.name: Shade of the Archmage
dalaran.note: Last boss: talk to Archmage Modera on the steps of the Violet Citadel, she opens the portal

dalaran.name: Lyn the Ignored
dalaran.note: Optional, summoned: use the Tome of Dalaran at the summoning circle in the room with planks over water on the east side of the Underbelly (per warcraft.wiki.gg); place approximate

deadmines.name: Sneed's Shredder
deadmines.note: Destroy the Shredder, then kill Sneed when he jumps out

deadmines.name: Mr. Smite
deadmines.note: Kill his two stealthed Blackguards first: twice in the fight he stuns the whole group

deadmines.name: Edwin VanCleef
deadmines.note: Kill his two Blackguards first; at half health he calls two more

diremaul_east.name: Pusillin
diremaul_east.note: Talk to him at the entrance and again each time he stops; he fights at the end of the chase

diremaul_east.name: Alzzin the Wildshaper
diremaul_east.note: Clear all trash on the ramp and around him first: imps pour in during the fight and leftover mobs join them

diremaul_east.name: Old Ironbark
diremaul_east.note: After Zevrim Thornhoof is dead: talk to him, he breaks open the door to Alzzin

diremaul_north.name: Captain Kromcrush
diremaul_north.note: Pull him back to cleared ground: his fear sends players into other packs; at 50% two elite ogres join

diremaul_north.name: Cho'Rush the Observer
diremaul_north.note: Heals King Gordok: kill him first

diremaul_north.name: Knot Thimblejack
diremaul_north.note: Have him make the ogre suit before you free him (Ogre Tannin from upstairs); once freed with the Gordok Shackle Key, he leaves

diremaul_west.name: Tendris Warpwood
diremaul_west.note: Kill the patrolling Ancients first: he calls them to help

diremaul_west.name: Immol'thar
diremaul_west.note: Shut down all five pylons to open the prison: kill every elemental around each pylon

diremaul_west.name: Lord Hel'nurath
diremaul_west.note: Warlocks only: appears in the Dreadsteed ritual

drownedcity.name: Zul'Alai
drownedcity.note: First boss, at the west end of the Sunken Hollow, up the hill after the entrance

drownedcity.name: Var'Taka
drownedcity.note: In the Deep Archives, with two Brinescale Priestesses who heal him; afterwards click the Glowing Pearl (together with Dreadrise's pearl it lowers a barrier)

drownedcity.name: Captain Dreadrise
drownedcity.note: At the Altar of the Serpent, leader of the Saltseer pirates; break the bubble around a trapped player before they drown; afterwards click the Glowing Pearl

drownedcity.name: Deathless Marrow
drownedcity.note: Deathless Marrow in the Eternal Amphitheater; kill at least three waves of adds before attacking him, each add killed makes him take more damage

drownedcity.name: Min'loth the Serpent
drownedcity.note: Last boss, at the Abyssal Dais; first a troll, then a serpent that poisons everyone and fears: remove the poison quickly, Tremor Totem helps

drownedcity.name: Primeval Elemental
drownedcity.note: Optional, also fine last: dive in at the south-east corner of the central pool (or the pool by Var'Taka); underwater, bring water breathing; kill the Undying Offerings to make him appear

drownedcity.name: Gill
drownedcity.note: Rare, not in every run: at the south-east edge of the central square, near the way down to the Primeval Elemental

drownedcity.name: Pyromancer Braxton
drownedcity.note: Rare, not in every run: with Saltseer pirates west below the Altar of the Serpent

excavationsite.name: Saltspine
excavationsite.note: Patrols the lake (Lost Marsh) below the entrance; pull him to a cleared, dry spot

excavationsite.name: Shadetooth
excavationsite.note: In Stalker's Thicket past the crocodile den; clear the stealthed raptors in the grass first, his roar fears players into them; keep him out of the water (reset)

excavationsite.name: Relic Guardian
excavationsite.note: Last boss; the Archival Panel to his right starts the fight; his knockback costs the tank threat, so damage dealers wait until the tank has him back

excavationsite.name: Highland Horror
excavationsite.note: Optional, only needed for an Alliance quest (no loot): north of the Lost Dig Site

gnomeregan.name: Grubbis
gnomeregan.note: Event: talk to Emi Shortfuse and hold off the trogg waves, then Grubbis and Chomper come

gnomeregan.name: Electrocutioner 6000
gnomeregan.note: On the platform in the middle of the Launch Bay, drops the Workshop Key. Then jump down into the bay

gnomeregan.name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
gnomeregan.note: He keeps switching on bomb machines: press the red button on each one to stop its walking bombs; assign one player to this

hallofthanes.name: Magmatus
hallofthanes.note: Called Magmatus in the game; in the Dark Iron cave (Dark Iron Ingress) east of the main hall; kill his summoner first

hallofthanes.name: Plunder
hallofthanes.note: Patrols the pillared hall before the bridge; pull him back into the cleared tunnel and tank him at a wall, his knockback throws players into other packs

hallofthanes.name: Durgen Dirgehammer
hallofthanes.note: Last boss, with two stone golems; clear the room first, his fear sends players into other mobs; then a lever in a vault opens a shortcut to the entrance

kroldok.name: Slavecrusher Grox
kroldok.note: First boss, wanders east of the entrance between the clearing and the side road above it, sometimes right at the first fork

kroldok.name: Twilight Commander Zarmok
kroldok.note: Patrols among the buildings in the middle, his death opens the large gate; his charge hits the farthest player, so stand close together

kroldok.name: Nar'gurk
kroldok.note: At the ritual circle on the stone walkway, with several casters; interrupt their casts; he mind-controls a player: damage them to half health to free them

kroldok.name: Overlord Mugg
kroldok.note: Called Overlord Mugg in the game; last boss, in the large hall at the top; kill his two centurions first; he leaps at three players, so spread out

kroldok.name: Handler Ashka
kroldok.note: Called War Handler Ashka in the game; optional, in the yard in the east with two wolves, many groups skip her; kill the wolves first

kroldok.name: Tunk
kroldok.note: Elite blacksmith right after, in the small forge; drops Krol'dok Moulding (starts a quest for a key)

kroldok.name: Zalfan Moonshadow
kroldok.note: Quest target, not a boss: in the yard in the north, on the way from the bridge tower to Nar'gurk

kroldok.name: Bossman Toof
kroldok.note: North-east end of the large wooden bridge: two centurions at the bridge start his fight; kill his shamans first; not in the game's boss list, tick him off by hand

lowerblackrock.name: Urok Doomhowl
lowerblackrock.note: Event: plant the Roughshod Pike in the skull pile and put Omokk's Head on it; ogre waves, then Urok

lowerblackrock.name: Overlord Wyrmthalak
lowerblackrock.note: At half health he calls two guards up the ramp; control or off-tank them

lowerblackrock.name: Spirestone Battle Lord, Spirestone Lord Magus

maraudon.name: Celebras the Cursed
maraudon.note: Kill Celebras first: he keeps summoning new adds; clean them up after him

maraudon.name: Landslide
maraudon.note: Ignore his rock adds and kill Landslide: they die with him

moltencore.name: Majordomo Executus
moltencore.note: Appears only after the other bosses except Lucifron are dead and their runes doused

moltencore.name: Ragnaros
moltencore.note: After Majordomo, go back west to the path by Garr and enter the lair; talk to Majordomo to summon him

naxxramas.name: Sapphiron
naxxramas.note: Opens after all four quarters: teleport from the upper platform of the entrance hall

onyxia.name: Onyxia
onyxia.note: Every raid member needs the Drakefire Amulet in their bags to enter

ragefire.name: Taragaman the Hungerer
ragefire.note: Keep the tank away from the lava edge: his Uppercut knocks his target back

razorfendowns.name: Tuten'kash
razorfendowns.note: Ring the gong three times: two spider waves, then Tuten'kash

razorfendowns.name: Plaguemaw the Rotting
razorfendowns.note: Only with the Belnistrasz quest: free him in the Murder Pens, then defend him at the idol here for about 5 minutes

razorfenkraul.name: Roogug
razorfenkraul.note: First boss: take the first passage left after the entrance, over the big root

razorfenkraul.name: Death Speaker Jargba
razorfenkraul.note: Kill the adds around him first. Interrupt his mind control (Dominate Mind) or dispel it from the controlled player

razorfenkraul.name: Agathelos the Raging
razorfenkraul.note: Sealed: first kill the Death's Head Seer and the two Ward Guardians at the seal

ruinsofahnqiraj.name: General Rajaxx
ruinsofahnqiraj.note: Talk to Lieutenant General Andorov to start; seven waves come before Rajaxx

ruinsofahnqiraj.name: Ossirian the Unscarred
ruinsofahnqiraj.note: Activate a crystal about every 40 seconds; without its debuff he hits extremely hard

ruinsoflordaeron.name: Witherfang
ruinsoflordaeron.note: Patrols King's Alley with broodlings, right after the entrance

ruinsoflordaeron.name: The Baron
ruinsoflordaeron.note: Called The Baron in the game; in the south-east by Lordamere Overlook; tank him with your back to a wall, his knockback can throw you into other packs

ruinsoflordaeron.name: Viktor the Vile
ruinsoflordaeron.note: In a burned-down house in Lordamere Overlook: click the fire in the fireplace, 5 waves, then Viktor; can also be done last

ruinsoflordaeron.name: The Abandoned
ruinsoflordaeron.note: On Market Street: walking up to the statue with red eyes starts three waves, then the boss; interrupt his Life Drain

ruinsoflordaeron.name: Bjork
ruinsoflordaeron.note: Patrols in the north-west, from Market Street north and then west

ruinsoflordaeron.name: Rath'mael
ruinsoflordaeron.note: Last boss, in the fenced-off part of the Lordaeron Graveyard (summoning circle); the way leads around the fence; step out of his Flamestrike

ruinsoflordaeron.name: Lordaeron Captain
ruinsoflordaeron.note: Rare, Horde only: can appear in the west once all other bosses are dead

aliases: 瑟尔林·卡斯迪诺夫教授
瑟爾林·卡斯迪諾夫教授
scholomance.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov
Darkmaster Gandling
scholomance.note: Appears once the 6 bosses around the Headmaster's Study are dead; he teleports players into side rooms, kill the adds there to get out

scholomance.name: Kirtonos the Herald
scholomance.note: Summon him with the Blood of Innocents at the brazier (quest, Blood Steward in the Reliquary)

scholomance.name: Kormok
scholomance.note: Summoned with the Brazier of Beckoning (quest)

shadowfang.name: Rethilgore
shadowfang.note: Then free the prisoner in the cell: he opens the way into the courtyard

shadowfang.name: Baron Silverlaine
shadowfang.note: Remove his curse from the tank at once: it cuts healing taken by 75%

shadowfang.name: Archmage Arugal
shadowfang.note: His curse turns a player against the group for 10 s: crowd-control them, do not kill them

shapersterrace.name: Titanosaur
shapersterrace.note: First boss: appears when you come near the door, then patrols the stone path; clear the packs along the path first, his fear scatters the group

shapersterrace.name: Ravasaur Hunters
shapersterrace.note: Izha'Rel and Tor'Rel, north-east of the tar pits on the Walk of Communion

shapersterrace.name: Direhorn Matriarch
shapersterrace.note: East of the lake around the Pillar of Assimilation; stand at her sides, not behind her (tail lash) or at the cliff edge

shapersterrace.name: Thunderhoof
shapersterrace.note: South-west of the lake; interrupt his lightning casts

shapersterrace.name: Venomridge
shapersterrace.note: South of the tar pits, before the double gate; his poison hits the whole group, cure it quickly

shapersterrace.name: Nanaya
shapersterrace.note: Last boss, on the island at the Pillar of Assimilation (causeway in the north); appears at the Titan Panel once all four Archival Panels are filled

shapersterrace.name: Cinder
shapersterrace.note: Optional, a fire raptor at Ruby Spring: appears after 15 red Power Crystals at the Archival Panel, so clear the fire elementals first; Nanaya needs this red panel too

shapersterrace.name: Bolt
shapersterrace.note: Optional, summoned at the same place as Venomridge before the double gate: hand in 15 yellow Power Crystals at the console; spread out, his lightning jumps

shapersterrace.name: Snowtalon
shapersterrace.note: Optional, summoned with 15 blue Power Crystals at the console; up in the north-west at the Tribunal of Ages, the fight is outside next to the dome

shapersterrace.name: Vitrix
shapersterrace.note: Optional, summoned with 15 green Power Crystals at the console; the crystals alone count for Nanaya, Vitrix hits very hard and can be skipped

shapersterrace.name: King Op
shapersterrace.note: Rare, not in every run: a large white gorilla in the south-east by Prismatic Talus (place from one addon, not seen in videos)

sm_armory.name: Herod
sm_armory.note: Whirlwind: step out of melee range. After his death 20 Scarlet Trainees rush in

sm_cathedral.name: Scarlet Commander Mograine
sm_cathedral.note: Clear all mobs in the chapel before you pull him

sm_cathedral.name: High Inquisitor Whitemane
sm_cathedral.note: Comes when Mograine dies; at half health she puts the group to sleep and raises Mograine; then kill her first

aliases: 高等審判官法爾班克斯
sm_cathedral.name: High Inquisitor Fairbanks
sm_cathedral.note: Turn the torch to open the door

sm_library.name: Arcanist Doan
sm_library.note: The Scarlet Key is here (opens Armory and Cathedral); when he shields himself at half health, get out of his line of sight before Detonation

stockade.name: Targorr the Dread
stockade.note: Spawns in one of three cells, the other two are marked.

stockade.name: Dextren Ward
stockade.note: Clear the cells around him first: his fear sends players into more prisoners

stratholme.name: Hearthsinger Forresten
stratholme.note: Rare in Classic; spawns here or at the north end of Market Row

stratholme.name: Balnazzar
stratholme.note: Appears as Grand Crusader Dathrohan, turns into Balnazzar at 40% health

stratholme.name: Baroness Anastari
stratholme.note: When she possesses a player, damage that player to half health to free them

stratholme.name: Magistrate Barthilas
stratholme.note: If you enter by the service entrance, he flees here; fight him at the gate before Slaughter Square

stratholme.name: Ramstein the Gorger
stratholme.note: Comes out once every abomination in Slaughter Square is dead; after his death a wave of undead, then Black Guard Sentries attack

stratholme.name: Baron Rivendare
stratholme.note: In the Slaughter House; kill his skeletons at once, he sacrifices them to heal himself

stratholme.name: Postmaster Malown
stratholme.note: Appears at the third postbox you open (keys from the Stratholme Courier), so the place varies

stratholme.name: Crimson Hammersmith
stratholme.note: Blacksmiths (quest Sweet Serenity): appears when you pick up the Blacksmithing Plans

stratholme.name: Ezra Grimm
stratholme.note: Optional: using his tobacco box starts the fight

aliases: Fabricant d’épées de la Garde noire
stratholme.name: Black Guard Swordsmith
stratholme.note: Blacksmiths (quest Corruption): appears when you pick up the Blacksmithing Plans

sunkentemple.name: Jammal'an the Prophet
sunkentemple.note: With Ogom the Wretched. The force field drops once the 6 trolls on the upper gallery are dead

sunkentemple.name: Dreamscythe
sunkentemple.note: Appears in the pit after Jammal'an's death. Fight away from the hole in the middle (Wing Flap)

sunkentemple.name: Weaver
sunkentemple.note: Appears in the pit after Jammal'an's death. Fight away from the hole in the middle (Wing Flap)

sunkentemple.name: Shade of Eranikus
sunkentemple.note: Clear all remaining dragonkin first: he calls them into the fight when pulled

sunkentemple.name: Atal'alarion
sunkentemple.note: Lowest level, via the stairs down at the entrance. Click the 6 statues of the lower gallery in the order S, N, SW, SE, NW, NE, then jump down to him

sunkentemple.name: Avatar of Hakkar
sunkentemple.note: Quest event: start it with the Egg of Hakkar or Yeh'kinya's Scroll, use the Hakkari Blood of the Bloodkeepers to put out the 4 flames

templeofahnqiraj.name: Viscidus
templeofahnqiraj.note: Freeze him with frost attacks, shatter him in melee, then kill the globs

uldaman.name: The Lost Dwarves
uldaman.note: Baelog, Eric and Olaf fight together (friendly to the Alliance). Baelog's chest holds the Gni'kiv Medallion for Ironaya

uldaman.name: Revelosh
uldaman.note: Drops the Shaft of Tsol, half of the staff that summons Ironaya: make sure to loot it

uldaman.name: Ironaya
uldaman.note: Combine the Shaft of Tsol (Revelosh) and the Gni'kiv Medallion (Baelog's chest) into the Staff of Prehistoria and use it in the Map Chamber to summon her

uldaman.name: Obsidian Sentinel
uldaman.note: Splits off Obsidian Shards during the fight: kill each shard as soon as it appears

uldaman.name: Archaedas
uldaman.note: Clear the room, then use the altar in front of him to wake him. Kill the stone adds he awakens

upperblackrock.name: Pyroguard Emberseer
upperblackrock.note: Use the Blackrock Altar to start: kill the Incarcerators, then Emberseer breaks free

aliases: Jefe de Guerra Rend Puño Negro
upperblackrock.name: Warchief Rend Blackhand
upperblackrock.note: Event: several waves in the arena, then Rend arrives on Gyth

upperblackrock.name: General Drakkisath
upperblackrock.note: On the Spire Throne with two Chromatic Elite Guards; kill the guards first while one player tanks or kites him away

upperblackrock.name: Solakar Flamewreath
upperblackrock.note: Optional: loot Father Flame at the pillar; 5 waves, then Solakar; kill the Rookery Hatchers first, they hatch eggs

wailingcaverns.name: Lady Anacondra
wailingcaverns.note: Position varies; interrupt Sleep and Healing Touch, as with every Fanglord

wailingcaverns.name: Mutanus the Devourer
wailingcaverns.note: After the four Fanglords (Anacondra, Cobrahn, Pythas, Serpentis) escort the Disciple of Naralex from the entrance; protect him from the waves, then Mutanus comes

zulfarrak.name: Witch Doctor Zum'rah
zulfarrak.note: Turns hostile when you come close and raises zombies from the graves. Destroy his ward quickly

zulfarrak.name: Nekrum Gutchewer
zulfarrak.note: Comes with Sezz'ziz as the last wave of the stairs event. Start it at the cages on top of the pyramid

zulfarrak.name: Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz
zulfarrak.note: Fights together with Nekrum and heals him: interrupt his heals

zulfarrak.name: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp
zulfarrak.note: With Ruuzlu. Behind the door Weegli blasts open after the stairs event: talk to Weegli before Bly

zulfarrak.name: Sergeant Bly
zulfarrak.note: Opening the cages starts the stairs event. Bly only fights if asked about the Divino-matic Rod (quest)

zulfarrak.name: Gahz'rilla
zulfarrak.note: Summoned at the gong with the Mallet of Zul'Farrak

zulgurub.name: High Priestess Arlokk
zulgurub.note: Strike the gong in her room to summon her

zulgurub.name: Hakkar
zulgurub.note: Kill the five high priests first; each one left alive gives him an extra ability

zulgurub.name: Edge of Madness
zulgurub.note: Douse the brazier with Gurubashi Mojo Madness; one of four bosses appears

zulgurub.name: Gahz'ranka
zulgurub.note: Fish him up here with a Mudskunk Lure (needs 5 Zulian Mudskunk from the pools by the altar)
